content: PostgresSaver.setup() creates checkpoint tables but LangGraph does not prune old checkpoints automatically - official docs explicitly recommend adding a cron job to delete checkpoints older than N days, otherwise the checkpoints table grows unbounded across all runs forever. thread_id must stay under 255 characters or PostgresSaver/AsyncPostgresSaver raise DB errors - recommend UUID-based thread_ids, not natural keys that could grow long. If using DeltaChannel-style incremental state (not the default), pruning is unsafe unless you either walk the ancestor write chain before deleting, force a full snapshot on the checkpoint being kept, or skip pruning for those threads - naive deletion can corrupt state reconstruction for a resumed run.
